description:
Start a CMIP6-morphed future EPW (Belcher 2005). scenario: ssp126, ssp245, ssp370, ssp585; horizon: any
decade 2030-2100; model: leave empty for the default, the CMIP6 ensemble median (per month and variable, the
median change of the ten CMIP6 models; recommended), or one id from list_cmip6_models. A EURO-CORDEX model takes ssp126, ssp245 or ssp585 only and
the file is the RCP2.6, RCP4.5 or RCP8.5 run, labelled as that RCP; ssp370 is refused. 3 credits.
name: generate_future_climate
